title: 基于AI的交叉口软基础设施分析：利用智能CCTV评估城市设计干预效果
summary: 本研究提出一种AI分析框架，利用现有CCTV基础设施和深度学习技术，评估临时行人避难所、路缘扩展等软干预措施对车辆速度和交通安全的影响。在明尼阿波利斯的实验显示，无信号交叉口的平均速度和85百分位速度分别下降18.75%和16.56%，信号交叉口也有显著改善。该方法为交通政策评估提供了快速、低成本、基于证据的新途径。
summary_en: This study introduces an AI-enabled analytics framework using existing CCTV and deep learning to evaluate soft infrastructure interventions (e.g., pedestrian refuges, curb extensions) on vehicle speed and safety. Results from Minneapolis show mean speed reductions up to 18.75% at unsignalized intersections and 20.0% at signalized ones, demonstrating a low-cost, evidence-based approach for transport policy evaluation.
